about.body: AGDS was started in 2018 by a group of engineers who felt consulting had drifted too far from writing code. Today the same principle holds: every engagement is staffed by senior engineers who ship alongside your team, not a rotating bench billed at senior rates.

faq.q: How is this different from a typical dev agency?
faq.a: Every engineer on your engagement is Staff or Principal level — no junior handoffs, no bench swap mid-sprint. You keep the same team from kickoff to handover.

faq.q: Who owns the code and IP?
faq.a: You do, from the first commit. There is no lock-in clause and no retained license — repositories, models and documentation transfer in full.

faq.q: Can you work inside our existing stack and tools?
faq.a: Yes. We plug into your GitHub, Jira and Slack inside 48 hours rather than asking you to adopt ours.

faq.q: Do you take equity or only cash engagements?
faq.a: Cash by default. We consider equity-inclusive arrangements for early-stage teams on a case-by-case basis.
